_comment: An entry means: this gate-shaped tool legitimately has NO automated invoker.
Every entry MUST carry a non-empty 'reason' of at least 12 characters explaining
why -- e.g. 'operator-invoked only: <why>'. An entry without a real reason is a
finding, not an exemption. Do NOT add a tool here to silence a genuine orphan:
an unwired real gate is a wiring bug, and belongs in CI or a git hook instead.
As of this file's creation the inventory has 4 confirmed orphans
port_fidelity_check). All four are real guardrails that SHOULD be wired, so they
are deliberately left failing rather than allowlisted.
